description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations -  Industrial Disputes between W. A.  Wijadasa vs. Sri Lanka Transport Board ; S. M. de Livera vs. Royal Colombo Gold Club ; P. A. M. Rathnapala vs. Sri Lanka Transport  Board
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act, including the appointment of arbitrators for industrial disputes and revocation of previous orders. It contains statutory instruments and legal procedures rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories. The content focuses on legal framework implementation and regulatory procedures for resolving industrial disputes.
